data.name: Mutmainnah
data.gender_notes: Mutmainnah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mutmainnah is an Islamic name for girls that signifies contentment, satisfaction, and tranquility. It is derived from the Arabic word 'mutma'in' which means 'satisfied' or 'content'. The name Mutmainnah carries the meaning “Contentment” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Mutmainnah usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A Mutmainnah is someone who finds peace and contentment in their faith and trusts in Allah's divine plan.
data.etymology: Mutmainnah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Contentment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mutmainnah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مُتَمنِّنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُتَمنِّنة من مشتق من "تمنّ" بمعنى "الراحة" و "الطمأنينة" أي السلم والطمأنينة في القلب. تشير إلى فتاة أو امرأة هادئة، و مطمئنة، و ذات قلبٍ سليم و منعم. لا يوجد إشارة مباشرة لها في القرآن الكريم، ولكنها تحمل معنى عميقاً من السلام الداخلي والرضى، وهو ما يعتبر أساساً في العقيدة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: متمنہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: متمنہ، ایک اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا معنی 'شान्तی، اطمینان اور سکون' ہے۔ یہ وہ لڑکیوں کے لیے ایک نام ہے جو امن اور راہِ اطمینان سے جڑی ہوئی ہے۔ اس کے ریشموں میں 'تمنّ' ہے جو 'شान्तی' اور 'طمأنينة' کا معنی رکھتا ہے۔ اس سے یہ نام ایک اہم دینی و فکری معانی کا حامل ہے کہ وہ خاتون امن، سکون اور راہِ اطمینان کی نمائندگی کرے گی۔

in_hindi.name: मुत्तमिनना
in_hindi.meaning: शान्ति, मन की सुकून और आत्मिक शांति
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुत्तमिनना, एक अरबी मूल के नाम हैं जिसका अर्थ है 'शान्ति, मन की सुकून और आत्मिक शांति।' यह नाम एक ऐसी लड़की या महिला के लिए उपयुक्त है जो शांत, स्थिर और मन के शान्ति से भरपूर हो। इसका मूल शब्द 'तمن' है जिसका अर्थ 'आशा' और 'शान्ति' होता है। इस नाम से महिला को आशा, शान्ति और आत्मिक उन्नति का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_english.name: Mutmainnah
in_english.long_meaning: Mutmainnah is an Arabic name meaning 'tranquility, peace of mind, contentment'. Derived from the root 'tmn', signifying 'to be at ease' or 'to feel secure', it embodies a sense of inner peace and satisfaction. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, the concept of tranquility and contentment is central to Islamic teachings. Mutmainnah is often associated with a woman who is serene, composed, and has a pure heart.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mutmainnah reflects the Arab and Islamic culture that values inner peace and contentment. In the Islamic tradition, finding inner happiness and tranquility is seen as an essential aspect of a prosperous and fulfilling life. The name Mutmainnah represents a girl who embodies this trait, and it is a reminder for everyone to strive towards finding happiness within and not relying on external circumstances or material possessions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mutmainnah also holds significant spiritual significance in Islam. Prophet Mohammad (PBUH) once said, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charitable deeds." This hadith emphasizes the importance of actions and deeds that bring us closer to Allah, and the state of contentment is a precondition to perform such acts. The name Mutmainnah reminds us of the need to be content and satisfied with Allah's blessings, which in turn, will allow us to focus on our spiritual growth and devotion to Him. Furthermore, Prophet Mohammad (PBUH) is reported to have said, "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, while both are good." The spiritual significance of the name Mutmainnah is that it represents a strong believer who is content and satisfied with Allah's will, even in the midst of trials and difficulties, and who continues to strive in His way.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mutmainnah bint Abdullah ibn Ja'far was a prominent female companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Mutmainnah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mutmainnah was a member of the Banu Asad tribe and was known for her piety and dedication to Islam. She is mentioned in several Hadiths and is considered a role model for Muslim women.

modern_usage.modern_context: Mutmainnah is remembered as a pious and devoted companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is often cited as an example of female dedication to Islam. She is studied in Islamic history courses and is a popular topic on Islamic websites and forums.
